entries.message: Scalar VM does not support object callback signatures
entries.reason: Host callbacks with object signatures need the VM-native object records and host views of S2.4.

entries.message: Scalar VM does not support reflection or plugin-loading builtins
entries.reason: These cases destroy their container through a reflected call; the VM refuses reflection until S4.5.
